gen-dafont-starborn-gf-anek-tamil: Anek Tamil reads modern and open, its big round lowercase bowls leaving c and s looking half unwrapped under a dreamy heading. Starborn's wide gaps and dark stripe of lowercase make it unmistakable.
gen-dafont-starborn-gf-anek-telugu: Starborn floats along with huge gaps between letters and a dark band of lowercase, while Anek Telugu keeps wide, tall bowls moving underneath. The heading dreams out loud; the sans just gets on with reading.
gen-dafont-starborn-gf-anuphan: Anuphan has big round lowercase bowls and open curves with clear gaps, which gives the text a tidy, unfussy look. Starborn is the one for drifting, dreamy display; Anuphan handles the sentences.
gen-dafont-starborn-gf-arimo: A thick, dark stripe of lowercase runs through every Starborn line, spaced out like something floating in a dream. That heading is made for atmosphere, while Arimo, a sans with a tall mean line and open rounded glyphs, does the plain reading.
gen-dafont-starborn-gf-armata: Dreamy, ethereal Starborn spreads its letters wide and lays a dark stripe of lowercase through each line. Armata follows in sans-serif, with spacious gaps between characters and tall lowercase bodies, so extended reading feels open and steady.
gen-dafont-starborn-gf-athiti: Starborn is ethereal, with wide gaps between letters and heavy lowercase. Athiti, a sans with a single flat line weight like sign-shop vinyl, has a high mean line and see-through s shapes, so Starborn supplies the mood and Athiti the steady, practical reading.
gen-dafont-starborn-gf-atkinson-hyperleg: Starborn drifts through dreamy, widely spaced lowercase in a thick dark stripe, set against a plain sans with clipped ascenders and capitals and wide-set terminals on s. Starborn is best at atmosphere; Atkinson Hyperlegible is best at being understood.

Atkinson Hyperlegible Mono has clipped capitals and wide-open spacing. Starborn earns its keep big and brief, where its dreamy gaps and dark lowercase stripe can stretch out, leaving the plain sans mono room to breathe.

Dreamy Starborn stretches wide gaps between letters and pulls a dark stripe of lowercase through every line. Atkinson Hyperlegible Next uses big-eyed lowercase and unsealed rounds, a sans that keeps long reading easy and approachable.
gen-dafont-starborn-gf-biryani: Starborn looks like a dark ribbon drifting through blank space, with dreamy gaps between its lowercase. Biryani, a sans with large-eyed e shapes and cable-like strokes of one thickness, keeps small counters unclogged over a whole page.
